author: mark
text:
Adapter streaming wire (§4.4)

Per-request `stream: true` routes complete through a JSON-Lines event
stream (message_start, content_block_start, text_delta, tool_use_delta,
content_block_stop, terminal message_stop with usage + api_calls).
Errors land in-band as `{"type":"error",...}` in either mode; SIGTERM
flushes a retryable terminal event from the signal handler and exits
within the 5s budget. describe.capabilities now advertises "streaming";
SCHEMA_VERSION stays on 2 (additive). Harness src/provider/wire grows
StreamEvent so src/prompt can parse a streaming response when v0.5
plumbs the UI.

100% tarpaulin; clippy clean (one pre-existing warning in client/streaming
from bl-64cf is out of scope). Tool-use payload is reserved per the
ball description: tool_use_delta carries only `index` at v0.2; v0.3
populates `partial_json`.
